resource: EasyEtsy Canonical Etsy Agentic & Development Tool Registry
scope_note: Comprehensive practical inventory of credible/current Etsy agentic, developer, automation, research, listing, personalization, POD, inventory and multichannel tools found during this research pass. Not literally every one-off app or abandoned repository on the internet.

tiers.D: Avoid as canonical foundation / policy or reliability risk

tools.name: Etsy Open API v3
tools.agentic_role: Read/write shop data, listings, inventory, orders, shipping, payments and other supported resources via OAuth-scoped endpoints.
tools.notes: Use Seller App access for the seller's own shop. Private/write calls require OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE. Every v3 request uses x-api-key as keystring:shared_secret.

tools.name: Etsy Dev MCP Server
tools.agentic_role: Makes Etsy's current OpenAPI/schema/auth knowledge available to MCP-capable coding agents.
tools.notes: Official endpoint: https://mcp.api.etsycloud.com/mcp . It is a developer-knowledge MCP, not a seller-action proxy; it does not itself execute Etsy shop API calls.

tools.name: Etsy OpenAPI specification (etsy/open-api)
tools.agentic_role: Generate typed clients, validate payloads, diff API changes, and power internal tool schemas.
tools.notes: Pin a known version in production and monitor upstream announcements/changes.

tools.name: Etsy Webhooks
tools.agentic_role: Event-driven workflows around order.paid, order.canceled, order.shipped, order.delivered and supported event types.
tools.notes: Verify signatures, persist event IDs, make consumers idempotent, and enqueue work rather than doing expensive work inline.

tools.name: Etsy Shop Manager native AI tools
tools.agentic_role: Seller insights, title assistance/bulk edits, and buyer-message writing assistance where available.
tools.notes: Useful to compare any external AI workflow against Etsy's own first-party experience and data.

tools.name: aserper/etsy-mcp
tools.agentic_role: Broad Etsy Open API v3 MCP wrapper; repository describes 37 tools covering listings, orders, shipping, reviews, inventory, payments and more.
tools.notes: TypeScript/MIT. Broad surface but its repository was pushed in April 2026, so reconcile with later 2026 Etsy API changes before using writes.

tools.name: avlihachev/etsy-mcp-server
tools.agentic_role: Manage listings, images, inventory, shipping profiles and seller taxonomy through MCP.
tools.notes: TypeScript/MIT; created/pushed July 2026 and explicitly reflects newer shared-secret/header and listing changes. Still third-party: pin, audit and test.

tools.name: alveyautomation/etsy-mcp
tools.agentic_role: Read-focused Etsy MCP with OAuth refresh/PKCE and variation inventory support.
tools.notes: Useful as a conservative read-only pattern; verify maintenance/current endpoint coverage.

tools.name: profplum700/etsy-mcp-server
tools.agentic_role: Community Etsy MCP implementation.
tools.notes: Inspect code, auth handling and API-version freshness before adoption.

tools.name: georgejeffers/etsy-mcp-server
tools.agentic_role: Community Etsy MCP implementation.
tools.notes: Long-tail GitHub option; do not assume production readiness from repo name alone.

tools.name: cbernatz/etsy-seller-mcp
tools.agentic_role: Seller-oriented community MCP.
tools.notes: Audit scopes, write safety, retry behavior and API freshness.

tools.name: markswendsen-code/mcp-etsy
tools.agentic_role: Community Etsy MCP.
tools.notes: Evaluate only if it fills a concrete gap not met by the canonical wrapper.

tools.name: Etsy SEO MCP community repos
tools.agentic_role: Community projects attempting keyword/listing analysis via MCP.
tools.notes: Examples include mallbin/etsy-seo-mcp, guardyanz/etsy-seo-mcp and gluebag/etsy-seo-mcp. Ensure data collection complies with Etsy terms; prefer licensed data providers.

tools.name: profplum700/etsy-v3-api-client
tools.agentic_role: Typed-ish programmatic Etsy v3 access with OAuth PKCE, refresh, rate limiting and caching patterns.
tools.notes: Good building block/reference if writing a first-party EasyEtsy tool gateway; reconcile methods with current OpenAPI.

tools.name: anitabyte/etsyv3
tools.agentic_role: Python Etsy Open API v3 client using OAuth2 PKCE.
tools.notes: Useful for Python workers, but generated/current OpenAPI clients may be safer for full endpoint parity.

tools.name: Make Etsy integration
tools.agentic_role: Native Etsy modules for listing, personalization, receipt/transaction, inventory and related workflows.
tools.notes: Strong bridge for rapid prototypes and human-in-the-loop automations before replacing critical paths with direct API services.

tools.name: Pipedream Etsy integration
tools.agentic_role: Etsy triggers/actions plus Node/Python steps and AI-agent workflow composition.
tools.notes: Useful when you want code escape hatches without maintaining the entire orchestration stack.

tools.name: n8n + Etsy API via HTTP Request
tools.agentic_role: Self-hosted workflow orchestration around direct Etsy API calls, queues, databases and AI nodes.
tools.notes: There is no need to depend on an unofficial Etsy node: use OAuth/HTTP Request against the official API. Community nodes such as mesutkisi11/n8n-nodes-etsy exist but should be audited.

tools.name: mesutkisi11/n8n-nodes-etsy
tools.agentic_role: Community Etsy node package for n8n.
tools.notes: Audit credentials, endpoint coverage and maintenance. Prefer official API via n8n HTTP nodes for a canonical system.

tools.name: Zapier
tools.agentic_role: Generic webhooks/custom actions/code can be used around Etsy.
tools.notes: Zapier's Etsy app page currently indicates native Etsy support is not yet available; do not architect around a nonexistent native connector.

tools.name: EverBee Research MCP
tools.agentic_role: Live Etsy product/shop/keyword research inside an MCP client such as Claude.
tools.notes: Launched August 2026. Connector: https://research-mcp.everbee.com/mcp . Treat sales/revenue/search numbers as provider estimates, not Etsy ground truth.

tools.name: EverBee
tools.agentic_role: Product research, shop analytics, keyword/tag research and estimated sales/revenue/conversion signals.
tools.notes: Large listing dataset and useful discovery. Paid Growth/Business plans include MCP access per current pricing. Triangulate estimates.

tools.name: eRank
tools.agentic_role: Keyword/trend research, competitor tracking, listing audits and AI listing assistance.
tools.notes: Useful inexpensive baseline. Third-party search volume/competition metrics are estimates; compare against Etsy Seller Stats/insights.

tools.name: Alura
tools.agentic_role: Keyword/product/shop research, Listing Helper, analytics, AI responses, A/B tests, Pinterest and Ads tooling.
tools.notes: Broad suite. Evaluate duplicate functionality before paying for EverBee + eRank + Alura simultaneously.

tools.name: Marmalead
tools.agentic_role: Keyword research, SEO/sales factor analysis and Boost optimization.
tools.notes: Strong specialist history in Etsy SEO; compare value with eRank/Alura before stacking subscriptions.

tools.name: EHunt / EtsyHunt
tools.agentic_role: Product database, keyword analysis, shop database and listing optimization.
tools.notes: Use as another directional signal, not as a source of exact Etsy search/sales truth.

tools.name: InsightFactory
tools.agentic_role: Trending Etsy searches, sales/competition signals and shop-connected recommendations.
tools.notes: Current site advertises daily trend recommendations and recent sales signals. Validate claimed signals with Etsy-native stats and another provider.

tools.name: Sale Samurai
tools.agentic_role: Keyword research, browser-assisted research, listing creator and A/B tests.
tools.notes: Current marketing claims 'real search volume', but a July 2026 independent test reported suspiciously narrow/high search-volume outputs. Cross-check everything.

tools.name: Roketfy
tools.agentic_role: Listing checker/writer, keywords, POD AI, product research, competitor analysis and review assistance.
tools.notes: Potentially useful one-stop UI; avoid duplicating with stronger data sources unless its workflow materially saves time.

tools.name: Toolsy
tools.agentic_role: Keyword difficulty/volume, long-tail discovery, competitor tracking and reports.
tools.notes: Useful as a niche research option; compare estimates across providers.

tools.name: Listadum
tools.agentic_role: Bulk create/edit, templates/snippets/profiles, scheduled publishing and listing/keyword/photo/video assistance.
tools.notes: Good UI-driven operator layer if you do not want to build every bulk-listing screen in EasyEtsy.

tools.name: Vela
tools.agentic_role: Bulk listing management/editing plus AI optimization.
tools.notes: Useful for catalog operations; compare its bulk model with Listadum and native Etsy Shop Manager.

tools.name: MyDesigns
tools.agentic_role: Bulk AI listing data, mockups, publishing and multi-channel operations.
tools.notes: Especially relevant if EasyEtsy becomes a high-volume personalized/POD asset pipeline.

tools.name: EtsyFlow
tools.agentic_role: Folder/asset-to-listing pipeline with mockups, video, title, description and tags.
tools.notes: Verify actual Etsy API usage, account safety and compliance before making it a critical dependency.

tools.name: Etsy Shop Manager bulk tools
tools.agentic_role: Bulk edit existing listings and copy listings.
tools.notes: The native UI does not provide general bulk upload of brand-new listings; API/partner tools are where EasyEtsy can add leverage.

tools.name: Printify
tools.agentic_role: Publish products to Etsy, import orders, automate fulfillment and support automated personalization.
tools.notes: Authorized Etsy partner. Automated personalization can map buyer text/dropdown/image inputs to products, reducing manual touches.

tools.name: Customily
tools.agentic_role: Maps Etsy native personalization questions (text/dropdown/file upload) into product templates and production-ready files.
tools.notes: Very relevant to the EasyEtsy personalized-gift thesis. As of July 2026 it supports Etsy's newer native personalization fields.

tools.name: Printful
tools.agentic_role: Etsy product push, stock/order fulfillment and personalization workflows.
tools.notes: Robust network. Its personalization workflow is more manual/draft-oriented than Printify's newer automated personalization flow, so test exact UX.

tools.name: Prodigi
tools.agentic_role: Direct Etsy store connection for print-on-demand fulfillment.
tools.notes: Potentially attractive where product catalog, geography or unit economics beat Printify/Printful.

tools.name: Gooten
tools.agentic_role: Etsy integration for products, orders and shipping-profile-related workflows.
tools.notes: Evaluate product-specific margins, QC and delivery SLAs rather than treating POD networks as interchangeable.

tools.name: Order Desk
tools.status: Recommended when fulfillment graph becomes complex
tools.agentic_role: Rule-driven order router across Etsy and many POD/fulfillment services; can pass tracking/status back.
tools.notes: High leverage if EasyEtsy uses multiple specialist printers/fulfillers and needs routing by product, geography, margin or SLA.

tools.name: LitCommerce
tools.agentic_role: Listing/inventory/order synchronization across Etsy and other channels, with AI description assistance.
tools.notes: Best considered after Etsy product-market fit; avoid introducing multichannel state-sync complexity too early.

tools.name: Shuttle
tools.agentic_role: Sync Etsy/Shopify products, inventory, orders/reviews; includes batch editing and optimization features.
tools.notes: Relevant when EasyEtsy wants Etsy as acquisition while preserving an owned storefront.

tools.name: CedCommerce Etsy Integration
tools.agentic_role: Sync Shopify product fields, inventory/price and Etsy listings/orders.
tools.notes: Current documentation is capable, but a recent Aug 2026 Shopify App Store review reports serious sync/international-pricing issues. Test on a small SKU subset first.

tools.name: Trunk
tools.agentic_role: Real-time Etsy inventory sync across channels and bundles.
tools.notes: Useful for physical inventory shared across Etsy/Shopify/etc.; Trunk acts as the inventory master using timestamped changes.

tools.name: Sumtracker
tools.agentic_role: Etsy inventory sync plus forecasting/purchase-order and multi-store inventory management.
tools.notes: Current docs note Etsy listings need SKUs; only active/inactive listings sync, and sold-out renewal behavior remains Etsy-controlled.

tools.name: Craftybase
tools.agentic_role: Raw-material inventory, production, COGS and Etsy-linked inventory/accounting operations.
tools.notes: Particularly useful if EasyEtsy expands from pure POD into handmade/assembled products where material-level costing matters.

tools.name: Xero Etsy integration
tools.agentic_role: Sync Etsy sales/refunds/fees and map tax/accounting data.
tools.notes: Use after transaction volume warrants automated bookkeeping. Keep finance truth separate from LLM reasoning.

tools.name: Apify Etsy scrapers / generic Etsy scrapers
tools.status: Do not use as canonical foundation without Etsy written authorization
tools.agentic_role: Can technically extract marketplace pages/data.
tools.notes: Etsy API Terms prohibit unauthorized automated systems/browser extensions/screen scraping of Etsy services/data. Use licensed research providers or permitted APIs instead.

tools.name: Playwright/Puppeteer browser agents against Etsy
tools.status: Avoid for Etsy data/actions unless explicitly authorized
tools.agentic_role: Browser automation can imitate seller/site interactions.
tools.notes: Brittle, security-sensitive and policy-risky. The canonical EasyEtsy design should use official API actions and browser automation only for clearly permitted non-Etsy destinations.

tools.name: MiniMax H3
tools.agentic_role: Open-weight text-to-video, I2V, reference-to-video with native stereo audio. 4-15 seconds at 768p. Reference mode enables character consistency across products.
tools.notes: #1 open-weight model on Artificial Analysis for T2V+audio and I2V+audio. NVFP4 quantization fits RTX 5090 (32GB) with ~12.5GB VRAM. INT8 tested on 5090 at ~16-18GB peak VRAM + 75GB system RAM. Reference-to-video is key for recurring characters (Santa, etc).

tools.name: LTX-2.5
tools.status: Recommended for fast drafts and iteration
tools.agentic_role: Fast text-to-video and I2V for rapid prototyping, recipe engineering, and budget batch runs. Good multishot/control and ComfyUI ecosystem.
tools.notes: Lower quality than H3 (~1061 vs ~1227 Elo T2V) but faster iteration. Excellent ComfyUI workflows. Keep alongside H3 for rapid prototyping before committing to full H3 renders.

tools.name: ComfyUI
tools.agentic_role: Visual node-based workflow editor for video generation pipelines. Community templates for H3 and LTX. Custom nodes for face insertion, character consistency. API mode for programmatic execution.
tools.notes: Industry standard for generative media workflows. H3 RunPod template exists. Use for all video generation orchestration.

tools.name: FFmpeg
tools.agentic_role: Titles, subtitles, music mixing, sound design, aspect ratio conversion (16:9 ↔ 9:16), color grading, transitions, final render and encoding.
tools.notes: Universal. Use as final step after GPU render to compose customer-facing output with branding, music, text overlays, and format variants.

tools.name: Vast.ai
tools.agentic_role: RTX 5090 rentals at $0.36-0.51/hr. Filter for 5090 + ≥96GB RAM + decent NVMe. $5 buys ~12.5 GPU-hours.
tools.notes: Best price/performance for batch generation. Primary infrastructure for H3 quantized workloads. Verify GPU availability and reliability scores before committing.

tools.name: RunPod
tools.agentic_role: RTX 5090 at ~$0.99/hr, RTX Pro 6000 96GB at ~$1.99-2.09/hr. Pre-built ComfyUI templates available.
tools.notes: More expensive than Vast but zero hassle. H3 ComfyUI template boots with workflows for H3 video+audio. Good for initial testing and production fallback.

tools.name: Prodigi
tools.agentic_role: Print individual greeting cards from ~£0.75-1.10 wholesale. API-driven. Supports personalized inside/outside printing. 24-72 hour turnaround.
tools.notes: Handles printing + shipping. We don't touch the physical card. Use for Movie Card product (£7.99 card + QR to movie).

tools.name: Lulu Print API
tools.agentic_role: Print-on-demand personalized books from PDFs. Global dropshipping. Supports AI/customer-input personalized books.
tools.notes: Use for future storybook product line. PDF → printed hardcover/softcover. Good integration path for expanding from cards to books.
